run_compare_txt_bin_models: run the test script to compare text and binary COLMAP SfM models for equality
test_compare_cameras: test two COLMAP camera dictionaries for matching id, width, height, and params
test_compare_images: test two COLMAP image dictionaries for matching qvec, tvec, camera_id, and point2D data
test_compare_points: test two COLMAP 3D point dictionaries for matching xyz, rgb, error, and image associations
run_roundtrip_write_read_model: run a roundtrip test that writes then reads back COLMAP models in txt and bin formats
